column1: # Minecraft call sites with no equivalent through renaming.
# Client brand (F3, MC|Brand packet, crash report): SteinLoader instead of vanilla.
# The crash report reads the graphics card name on the thread that crashed; with no GL context there, LWJGL 3 aborts the JVM.
# Server resource packs (core/ServerPacks): level:// only under saves/<world>/resources.zip (NetHandlerPlayClient.handleResourcePack),
# the pack cache only for packs this account has used (ResourcePackRepository.downloadResourcePack) and no download to a
# local address (HttpUtil's download task), so a server cannot probe the player's files, link accounts or reach the local network.
# Item edges (engine/ItemEdges): ItemModelGenerator.isTransparent also takes nearly transparent pixels (alpha up to 16) as
# empty, as the clients resource packs are made on do; otherwise an item painted on an alpha-1 background comes out flat.
# ClassInheritanceMultiMap (engine/ClassMapGuard): its class list is one static HashSet that the client thread walks
# (a new chunk) while the integrated server adds to it; the walk threw ConcurrentModificationException and the chunk
# packet was lost (a hole in the world). The additions take the set's lock and the walk goes over a copy.
# A player lost after a long teleport (engine/PlayerUnload): when the chunk they stood in before the teleport is unloaded
# in the same tick, before updateEntities moves them, Chunk.onChunkUnload no longer unloads a player who is still in the
# world (1.8.9 removed them from loadedEntityList and they were never ticked again until a dimension change).
# The local player's look follows the camera (engine/LookFix, MC-67665, as from 1.11): the body of EntityLivingBase.getLook.
# Hotbar keys on mouse buttons work in inventories (engine/MouseHotbar): the click GuiScreen.handleMouseInput hands on.
# The block placing sound plays at once (engine/PlaceSounds, as from 1.9): the placing items' playSoundEffect, and the
# server's copy of it skipped once in NetHandlerPlayClient.handleSoundEffect.
# An entity above the build limit or below 0 is not drawn black (engine/LightCache.loaded, as from 1.9): the loaded
# check of Entity.getBrightness asks of the column (getBrightnessForRender's body already does).
# Player model fixes (engine/ModelFixes): the item in the thin (Alex) arm half a pixel out (MC-72397, as from 1.9);
# the first-person arm not in the riding pose of the last player drawn; depth writes back on after each entity layer
# (the charged creeper, spider eyes and wither aura on an invisible mob left them off for the rest of the frame).
# Map textures let go when the world changes (engine/MapCleanup): before each Minecraft.loadWorld.
# The chunk search's start chunks as whole columns with the camera above the build limit or below 0 (engine/TerrainSeeds,
# as from about 1.14): the seeding's frustum test in RenderGlobal.setupTerrain, between the queue's creation and the loop.
# Banners sway from their phase, not the whole world time in float (engine/BannerSway, as from about 1.14): in
# TileEntityBannerRenderer.renderTileEntityAt, the banner from getWorld and the world time reduced to the period.
# Which tile entities are drawn (engine/TileFixes): none for an invalid (removed) one, the body of
# TileEntityRendererDispatcher.getSpecialRenderer; the beacon only in the world-wide set, not also in its compiled chunk.
# Camera-facing pitch negated in the front view (engine/TagPitch, as from 1.9): after RenderManager.cacheActiveRenderInfo.
# Heads drawn with blending (engine/SkullBlend): around the model's render in TileEntitySkullRenderer.renderSkull.
# The alpha test arrows, the fishing bobber and the fire overlay need (engine/ProjectileAlpha): from their pushMatrix to
# the end of their drawing (Render.doRender for the arrow and the bobber, the fire's popMatrix).
# The fog colour's brightness at the eyes, not the feet (engine/FogEye): in EntityRenderer.updateRenderer.
# Links and the resource pack folder (engine/PackFiles, core/DesktopOpen): the reflective Desktop.getDesktop/browse of
# GuiScreenResourcePacks.actionPerformed and GuiScreen.openWebLink go to xdg-open on Linux (Desktop elsewhere), off the game
# thread; the packs left off the list on Done close their zip (it stayed locked on Windows).
# Options saved when an options screen closes (engine/ScreenClose, as from 1.14): the onGuiClosed of displayGuiScreen; the
# language screen also re-wraps the chat.
# Held keys re-read when a screen closes (engine/KeyResync, as from 1.12): after setIngameFocus grabs the mouse.
# Sound fixes (engine/SoundFixes): the pause menu pauses and resumes only the sources that were playing (as from 1.14),
# and an unknown sound warns once in SoundManager.playSound.
# Death screen buttons back after a resize (engine/GameOverButtons): GuiGameOver.initGui resets its timer, before its first call.
# Potion levels above IV (engine/PotionLevels, as from 1.13): the inventory's effect names and the potion tooltip.
# Chat (engine/ChatFixes): GuiNewChat.deleteChatLine past null lines (the click above the lines goes through VanillaHud).
# Screen input (engine/ScreenInput, as from 1.13): GuiScreen.handleInput stops reading keys once a click replaced the screen,
# and dispatchKeypresses no longer takes a character without a key (IME) as a key code.
# Mipmap slider applied on release (engine/MipmapSlider, as from 1.14): GuiOptionSlider's press and drag keep the level
# pending (and show it), its mouseReleased applies it.
# No pumpkin overlay in spectator mode (engine/SpectatorPumpkin): renderPumpkinOverlay in renderGameOverlay.
# NBT array sizes charged in long (engine/NbtArraySize, as in later versions): the bodies of NBTTagIntArray.read and
# NBTTagByteArray.read; a huge length wrapped the int product, passed the size tracker and allocated hundreds of MB.
# Packet counts checked against the bytes left before allocating (engine/PacketCounts): the count of S27 explosion
# blocks, of S26 bulk chunks and of PacketBuffer.readByteArray; S22, S13 and S34 read other varints in the same method,
# so their readPacketData bodies are replaced by the same reading with the check.
# Unknown item ids read as an empty slot (engine/UnknownItems, as from 1.11): the body of
# PacketBuffer.readItemStackFromBuffer; a stack with a null item crashed the tooltip and the slot drawing.
# An entity effect with a potion id 1.8.9 does not have is left out (engine/PotionIds): the addPotionEffect of
# NetHandlerPlayClient.handleEntityEffect; the next tick read Potion.potionTypes[id] and crashed with "Ticking entity".
# The particle count of one S2A packet capped at what EffectRenderer keeps (engine/ParticlePacketCap): both reads of
# getParticleCount in NetHandlerPlayClient.handleParticles; 2^31 particles froze the game thread for minutes.
# "Unable to locate sign at" goes to the log, not the chat (engine/SignChat, as from 1.9): handleUpdateSign's
# The game-thread pass of each queued packet (engine/QueuedPackets): skipped for the client's handler once its channel
# closed (as from 1.14), a player spawned with no tab list entry left out (handleSpawnPlayer threw an NPE), and the
# plugin message buffer released after handleCustomPayload (only MC|TrList was).
# "Error executing task" of Util.runTask with the full trace once per kind of error, then one line per 10 s with the
# count (engine/TaskErrors): a packet handler failing many times per second flooded the log.
# The network thread group of the server list's compatibility ping (OldServerPinger.tryCompatibilityPing) also goes
# through engine/Net.lazy, one thread at a time (LazyLoadBase.getValue has no lock; see redirects-mods.tsv).
# Server list and address crashes (engine/ServerListFixes): a favicon that is not Base64 (decoded before
# ServerListEntryNormal.prepareServerIcon's try), a stale LAN index in ServerSelectionList.getListEntry, an address
# made only of colons (ServerAddress.fromString's empty split), a host IDN.toASCII rejects (ServerAddress.getIP), and
# the typed address trimmed when the add/edit server screen and direct connect save it.
# TextureManager.deleteTexture also removes the texture from the manager (engine/TextureDelete, MC-98707): the deleted
# textures stayed on the heap and every resource reload loaded them again.
# One shared panorama background texture for every main menu (engine/MenuBackground): GuiMainMenu.initGui made and
# registered a new 256x256 DynamicTexture on every open and resize, never freed.
# BlockRedstoneTorch.toggles becomes a WeakHashMap (engine/TorchToggles, as from 1.13): after the torches are created in
# Block.registerBlocks; the HashMap kept every single player world a torch toggled in.
# EnchantmentHelper's static iterators let go of the entities and damage source after each use (engine/EnchantIterators):
# every applyThornEnchantments, applyArthropodEnchantments and getEnchantmentModifierDamage, under one lock because the
# client and the integrated server threads share the iterators.
# The stopped integrated server leaves MinecraftServer's static instance (engine/ServerRelease, as from 1.9): after
# systemExitNow at the end of MinecraftServer.run, on the server thread.
# options.txt written to a temporary file and moved over the old one when complete (engine/OptionsWriter): the
# FileWriter of GameSettings.saveOptions; a crash mid-write left an empty file and every setting reset.
# The access token out of the logs (core/TokenLog): the Minecraft constructor logs "(Session ID is token:...)".
# The frame limit up to 1000 fps (engine/FramerateScale): 10-250 by 10, 300-1000 by 50, then unlimited; the slider
# conversions of GameSettings.Options and the new maximum set before options.txt is read (260, the old unlimited, stays unlimited).
